span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE TERM'S TWO SENSES ARE SEPARATED BY THEIR HISTORY: 'long memory' initially meant the slow decay of the autocorrelation function - anything slower than exponential - and over time acquired the more precise meaning that the function is not integrable, and more precisely still that it decays as a power law with exponent less than one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE TECHNICAL SENSE IS DEFENDED AS THE ONLY ESTIMABLE ONE: the recent literature assumes long memory in the technical sense, and the authors add that meaningful results can probably ONLY be obtained under such a specification, since the asymptotic behaviour of the covariance function cannot be estimated without assuming a specific form for it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE QUESTION IS DECLARED UNANSWERABLE AS POSED, and the authors then supply a different instrument rather than a different answer: stated in terms of the asymptotic behaviour of the autocorrelation function the long memory question simply cannot be answered, but explicit expressions still allow the dependence structure to be analysed
span.note: about this quote: Span re-sliced at drafting: the staged text splices footnote 1 AND a page number between 'This implies' and its own subordinate clause ('This implies 1Actually H corresponds ... see Section 2.1. 3 that when stated in term of...'), so the quote begins after the splice. Extraction damage, not authorial. Damage class C.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A WIDELY ACCEPTED STYLIZED FACT IS EXPLAINED AS AN ARTEFACT OF ITS OWN DETECTOR: the model has no long memory property, and yet the classical statistical procedures designed to detect volatility persistence TEND TO CONCLUDE THAT LONG MEMORY IS PRESENT in data the model generated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the evidence for the stylized fact is dated rather than dismissed: the analyses supporting it use data that PREDATE high-frequency electronic trading, and the authors note the evidence has never satisfied the remaining doubters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE NEW NAME IS CHOSEN TO CARRY THE DEPARTURE: an existing model is adopted and renamed, with the new word picked to underline the single parameter inequality that separates it from its parent
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: in the process used, ONE PARAMETER CONTROLS BOTH PROPERTIES AT ONCE - regularity and long memory stand in one-to-one correspondence through the Hurst parameter - so a claim about smoothness is inseparably a claim about memory
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A WIDESPREAD BELIEF IS MET WITH A COUNTEREXAMPLE RATHER THAN AN ARGUMENT: the model is offered as a counterexample to the widespread belief that the explosion of the volatility smile at short expiries implies the presence of jumps
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE MODEL IS OFFERED AGAINST TWO SEPARATE REQUIREMENTS rather than one - consistency with the empirically observed properties of the volatility time series AND consistency with the shape of the volatility surface - and the claim is stated as POTENTIAL, not as achievement
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the smoothness estimate is reported as a RANGE ACROSS ASSETS rather than a single fitted number, and it is accompanied by two further empirical properties of the increments - approximate normality and a monofractal scaling of the moments - which together are what licenses the modelling choice
span.note: about this quote: The span contains 'H¨older' for 'Hölder' - the diaeresis is emitted BEFORE its base letter by the PDF extraction. The quote is still an exact substring and anchors correctly; the damage is in what a reader of the tag sees, not in the provenance. None of the four shapes test_damaged_quote_is_annotated.py looks for covers this, so it is annotated by hand.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the scaling result is established at usual observation time scales
span.note: what this limits: the scaling result, over the range examined: AT LEAST AT USUAL TIME SCALES OF OBSERVATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Smoothness estimates based on whole-trading-day realized variance are expected to be biased upwards because integration smooths the process.
span.note: what this limits: the smoothness estimates specifically: WE EXPECT ESTIMATES OF THE SMOOTHNESS OF THE VOLATILITY PROCESS TO BE BIASED UPWARDS, INTEGRATION BEING A REG[ularising operation] - the direction of the bias is stated
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Volatility is never observed directly, so the key quantity m(q, Δ) can only be computed from proxies.
span.note: what this limits: every quantity computed in the paper: THE VOLATILITY PROCESS IS NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVABLE, AND AN EXACT COMPUTATION OF m(q, delta) IS NOT POSSIBLE IN PRACTICE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper only treats the volatility time series; whether the model is consistent with observed option prices is deferred.
span.note: what this limits: the option-pricing implications: A MORE DETAILED ANALYSIS OF THE CONSISTENCY OF OUR MODEL WITH OPTION PRICES IS LEFT FOR A FUTURE ARTICLE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The property cannot be estimated without first assuming the functional form whose presence is at issue.
span.note: what this limits: any estimate of long memory in volatility: the asymptotic behaviour of the covariance function cannot be estimated without assuming a specific form for it, so the specification is an input to the result rather than an output
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: As the term is now defined, the field's central question about volatility cannot be answered at all.
span.note: what this limits: the debate over whether volatility has long memory: stated in terms of the asymptotic behaviour of the autocorrelation function, the paper says the question simply cannot be answered
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Standard procedures report the property in data generated by a model that does not have it, which the authors offer as the reason the field accepted it as a stylized fact.
span.note: what this limits: the widely accepted stylized fact that volatility has long memory: classical procedures for detecting volatility persistence conclude it is present in data simulated from a model that has no long memory property at all
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: fractional Brownian motion with a Hurst exponent below 1/2 used as the model of log-volatility, in place of the standard semimartingale volatility models of finance
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a detailed test of the model against observed option prices - NOT performed, and deferred to a future article
span.note: eliminates: the model fitting volatility time series while failing on the option prices it would be used to compute, which is the comparison the paper itself says its predecessors fail
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
